summary: KIDZ AI Inc. filed an 8-K on July 28, 2026, announcing that its Board authorized a 50% increase in its share repurchase program from $2,000,000 to up to $3,000,000 of Class B common stock. Purchases may occur via open market, block trades, private negotiations, or Rule 10b-18 plans. The program does not obligate repurchases and may be suspended or modified. A press release was issued on July 28, 2026. This is a capital return event; the company expands buyback capacity, signaling cash generation and shareholder return intent. Watch for actual repurchase activity and market conditions influencing execution.
